description: Switch a Stripe promotion code OFF (active:false) or back on (active:true), or change its metadata. Pass promotionCodeId (promo_…) or the code itself. Switching a code off ALWAYS needs confirm:true, test keys included, because anyone holding it from an ad is then refused at checkout. Read back; a code Stripe will not reactivate (its coupon is no longer valid) is reported, not claimed. Needs Stripe connected (Settings > Connectors > Stripe, or connect_connector).

active.description: false switches the code off; true switches it back on

code.description: the customer-typable code text, if promotionCodeId is not given

confirm.description: true to switch a code off, as well as to confirm a live-key write

metadata.description: key/value metadata to set on the code

promotionCodeId.description: promotion code id, promo_...; give this or code

name: update_stripe_promotion_code
title: update stripe promotion code
